title: Fundraise for Toynbee Hall
intro: Bring people together and raise funds to support Toynbee Hall’s work with East London communities.

blocks.heading: Make it your own
paragraphs: From personal challenges to workplace and community events, fundraising is a practical way to help sustain local advice and community programmes.

blocks.heading: Get support
paragraphs: Contact the fundraising team to discuss your idea and how to get started.
